_meta.note: The Bed Mesh extension's own texts. Copy this file to <tag>.json to translate; a key you leave out falls back to the line here.
bedmesh.level.title: 1. Measure the bed
bedmesh.level.body: Prusa Connect sends the printer G28 and G29: it homes and probes the bed. Heat the bed to your printing temperature first, and make sure the bed is clear.
bedmesh.level.confirm: The printer will home and probe the bed. Is the bed clear?
bedmesh.level.started: The printer is leveling the bed. When it finishes, read the mesh over USB or paste the output of M420 V below.
bedmesh.paste.title: 2. Paste the mesh
bedmesh.paste.body: Plug the printer into this computer with a USB cable and press Read over USB, or send M420 V from any serial console (Pronterface, or a terminal at 115200 baud) and paste everything it printed here. The extension reads the Bed Topography Report out of it.
bedmesh.paste.note: Note, such as the sheet or what you changed
bedmesh.view.mismatched: The baseline has a different grid, so this mesh is shown on its own.
bedmesh.heatmap.label: Bed mesh heatmap of {cols} by {rows} points, seen from above
bedmesh.surface.label: Bed mesh as a 3D surface. Drag to turn it.
bedmesh.surface.hint: Drag to turn the bed. The heights are exaggerated so that tenths of a millimetre can be seen.
bedmesh.history.title: 3. History
bedmesh.history.empty: No mesh is saved for this printer yet.
bedmesh.fault.INVALID_BODY: The request could not be read.
bedmesh.fault.NO_MESH_IN_TEXT: No bed mesh was found in the pasted text. Paste everything the printer printed after M420 V.
bedmesh.fault.TEXT_TOO_LONG: The pasted text is too long. Paste only the output of M420 V.
bedmesh.fault.MESH_NOT_FOUND: That mesh is no longer in the history.
bedmesh.fault.UNAVAILABLE: The mesh history is not available right now. Try again in a moment.
bedmesh.usb.hint: Pick the printer's port in the browser's dialog. The page sends M420 V and nothing else.
bedmesh.usb.unavailable: Reading over USB needs Chrome or Edge on a computer, with Prusa Connect opened over HTTPS or on localhost. You can still paste the output of M420 V.
bedmesh.usb.failed: The printer could not be read over USB. Check the cable, and close any other program that holds the port.
